policies: All sample orders are INR. Monetary *_cents fields contain paise: divide by 100.0 for INR.
Use all available dates unless the question specifies a date filter; state the chosen scope.
Aggregate independent child tables (items, discounts, payments, refunds) before joining totals to avoid fan-out.
Use actual applied order_discounts amounts; do not apply promotion percentages a second time.
Inventory is the current snapshot; inventory_movements is the history, not another stock balance to add to it.
Business definitions do not grant data access. Application table permissions and actual schema remain authoritative.

ambiguous_terms.revenue: Do you mean gross order value, discounted order value, captured payments, or net collected cash?
ambiguous_terms.profit: Which cost basis should be used? Supplier reference costs do not establish historical cost of goods or recognized profit.

sales.description: Customer orders, products, discounts, promotions and segments

payments.description: Captured payments, refunds, returns and outstanding balances

inventory.description: Stock, warehouses, suppliers, purchasing, receipts and shipping

metrics.name: Order count
metrics.definition: COUNT of orders; no status filter unless requested.

metrics.name: Gross order value
metrics.definition: SUM(quantity * unit_price_cents) before discounts. Include all statuses unless specified.

metrics.name: Discounted order value
metrics.definition: Gross order value minus actual applied discounts, aggregating both independently by order.

metrics.name: Captured payments
metrics.definition: SUM(payments.amount_cents) where status=succeeded. Failed/pending attempts do not count. Captured cash is before refunds.

metrics.name: Successful refunds
metrics.definition: SUM(refunds.amount_cents) only where status=succeeded. Pending refunds do not reduce cash.

metrics.name: Net collected cash
metrics.definition: Successful captured payments minus successful refunds. Aggregate cash streams separately. For monthly cash, use payment date and refund date respectively, not order date.

metrics.name: Outstanding order balance
metrics.definition: Gross order amount minus applied discounts minus succeeded payments, independently aggregated by order. Exclude cancelled orders. Do not add refunded cash back as debt.

metrics.name: Stock on hand
metrics.definition: Current inventory.quantity by product and warehouse. Do not add movement totals to this snapshot. Ask for a low-stock threshold if none is specified.

metrics.name: Outstanding inbound units
metrics.definition: Ordered purchase quantity minus purchase_receipt movements, grouped by purchase order and product. Exclude cancelled purchases.

relationship_rules: Entity joins use declared primary/foreign keys; shared names or region alone do not establish identity.
customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id; orders.order_id = payments.order_id; payments.payment_id = refunds.payment_id.
returns links to an order_items row using both order_id and product_id; use both columns.
purchase_order_items and receipt movements join using both purchase_order_id and product_id.
inventory and inventory_movements join using both warehouse_id and product_id, after aggregating movements.
A NULL refunds.return_id can mean a cancellation refund. A NULL order_discounts.promotion_id means a manual discount.
